thought.text: I've reverted the redundant duplicate. Now I need the actual behavioral fix. The bug: for `restaurant__place__country`, when processing `place`, `prev_field` is the FK `restaurant` whose target field is Restaurant's pk (`place`), so `place` is skipped from relation_parts. The fix is to only skip when the field is not itself a relation.
